description: Conservation profile of the HTH_NOL4 domain and Foldseek PDB100 hit significance
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, re, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"research-agent"})
can="".join(S.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/O94818.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:])
res=S.get("https://search.foldseek.com/api/result/vm1A2fX9igPoHqNgsSJqLn3xxxbdTnsCgJEl9A/0",timeout=180).json()
als=[a for db in res['results'] if db['db']=='afdb50' for a in (db['alignments'] if not isinstance(db['alignments'][0],list) else [x for s in db['alignments'] for x in s])]
pdbhits=[a for db in res['results'] if db['db']=='pdb100' for a in (db['alignments'] if not isinstance(db['alignments'][0],list) else [x for s in db['alignments'] for x in s])]
def grp(n):
    n=n.lower()
    if 'protein 4-like' in n or 'nol4l' in n: return 'NOL4L'
    if 'nucleolar protein 4' in n or re.search(r'\bnol4\b',n): return 'NOL4'
cols={i:[] for i in range(1,96)}
for a in als:
    g=grp(str(a.get('target',''))); 
    if not g or a['eval']>1e-5: continue
    qp=a['qStartPos']
    for qc,tc in zip(a['qAln'],a['dbAln']):
        if qc!='-':
            if 1<=qp<=95: cols[qp].append(tc)
            qp+=1
ident=np.array([ (sum(1 for x in cols[p] if x==can[404+p])/len(cols[p])) if cols[p] else np.nan for p in range(1,96)])
xs=np.arange(406,501); basic=np.array([can[i-1] in 'KR' for i in xs])
inpatch=(xs>=454)&(xs<=473)
u=stats.mannwhitneyu(ident[inpatch],ident[~inpatch],alternative='two-sided')

fig,axs=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(13,7.6),gridspec_kw={'height_ratios':[1.4,1]})
ax=axs[0]
ax.bar(xs,ident,color=['#c53030' if b else '#718096' for b in basic],width=0.85)
ax.axvspan(454,473,color='#f6ad55',alpha=.25,zorder=0)
ax.axhline(np.nanmean(ident),ls='--',c='k',lw=0.9,label='domain mean = %.3f'%np.nanmean(ident))
for s,e,lab in [(407,422,'H1'),(434,447,'H2'),(452,470,'H3'),(487,499,'H4')]:
    ax.plot([s,e],[1.09,1.09],lw=5,solid_capstyle='butt',color='#2b6cb0'); ax.text((s+e)/2,1.13,lab,ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylim(0,1.22); ax.set_xlim(405,501); ax.set_ylabel("fraction identical to human NOL4")
ax.set_xlabel("NOL4 residue (IPR056549 domain)")
ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc='lower left')
ax.set_title("Conservation of the 'HTH_NOL4' domain across 349 vertebrate NOL4/NOL4L sequences (265 taxa; red = Lys/Arg)\n"
 "Basic patch 454-473 is near-invariant but NOT more conserved than the rest of the domain (Mann-Whitney p=%.2f)"%u.pvalue,fontsize=10)

ax=axs[1]
ev=[a['eval'] for a in pdbhits]; names=[str(a['target']).split(' ',1)[-1][:46] for a in pdbhits]
o=np.argsort(ev)[:10]
ax.barh(range(10),[-np.log10(ev[i]) for i in o],color='#a0aec0')
ax.set_yticks(range(10)); ax.set_yticklabels([names[i] for i in o],fontsize=7.5); ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.axvline(-np.log10(0.001),c='r',ls='--',lw=1.2); ax.text(-np.log10(0.001),9.6,' significance threshold E=1e-3',color='r',fontsize=8,va='top')
ax.set_xlabel("-log10(Foldseek E-value)"); ax.set_xlim(-3.2,3.5)
ax.set_title("Foldseek 3Di-AA search of NOL4 406-500 vs PDB100: top 10 hits. Best E = %.1f. No DNA- or RNA-binding fold, no HTH."%min(ev),fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print("domain mean identity %.3f; patch mean %.3f; rest %.3f; MWU p=%.3f"%(np.nanmean(ident),np.nanmean(ident[inpatch]),np.nanmean(ident[~inpatch]),u.pvalue))
print("Best PDB100 E-value: %.2f"%min(ev), "| n hits:",len(ev))
